about: Ani's 1978 choices for the Cinderella film (pass 1), for the Mini-Ani's fidelity report. The test only reports how often the Mini-Ani agrees and asserts a recorded floor; the knowledge is never tuned to raise it (Ken's legitimacy rule, AI-TR-540 Chapter X C).
provenance: Ani's choice-point file CP 29 (14 September 1978), ani-revival/original/7005017/cp.29, as read by the ani-revival project (reports/pass1-choices.txt, which its run-pass1 tool reproduces 102 of 102), and checked against cp.29 itself. Copied read-only on 9 October 2026: 4 characters x 12 absolute choice points.

mapping.PATH-JAGGEDNESS: jerkiness (low is steady, high is jerky)
mapping.ATTRACTION-TOWARDS-FRIENDS: friends (negative is wary, positive is drawn; the miniature's three values collapse Ani's signed ones)
mapping.not compared: RHYTHMIC-LEVEL, ACCELERATION, REPETIVENESS, PATH-LENGTH and ATTRACTION-TOWARDS-ENEMIES have no element in the miniature, which has five looks elements instead

floorNote: Recorded on 9 October 2026 (Agent Kit 1.14.0) with the shipped knowledge: 17 of the 28 compared choices agree (Cinderella 5, the Stepmother 5, the Godmother 2, the Prince 5). A change of knowledge may lower it only with a reason, and must never be made to raise it.
